text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer— may I ask for your opinion?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Right now, our class is... in the middle 
of deciding our classroom goal for next 
month, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
They were split between "Eat a lot, grow a 
lot," "Total victory!", "Occasional 
rewards," and "Sleep"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...The atmosphere in the class grew tense 
as well. I tried to think of a way... to 
respect everyone's feelings and bring them 
together, but—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Eat a lot, sleep well, and grow big! Win 
together and on to the reward♪" ...How 
does that sound?
